file: File:Adolf Hitler - vom Schüler zum Führer.webm
title: Adolf Hitler - vom Schüler zum Führer
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Felina Czycykowski/Stefan Gierer/Malte Roethig/Maximilian Mohr
description: As a youth, Hitler was a dreamer and not a particularly good student. In 1933 he took power in Germany as the undisputed leader of his party. How could that happen?

file: File:Angkor - Zentrum des Königreichs der Khmer (CC BY-SA 4.0).webm
title: Angkor - Zentrum des Königreichs der Khmer (CC BY-SA 4.0)
artist: ZDF/Terra X/interscience film/Faber Courtial/Gero von Boehm/Alexander Hein/Andreas Tiletzek, Jörg Courtial
description: The impressive temple ruins of Angkor are located in Cambodia. The huge complex has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1992. What was it like here many hundreds of years ago?

title: Angriff von Retroviren
artist: 3sat/nano/Docstation/Johan von Mirbach/Anna Grün/Riccardo Giese/Nico Schlegel, Max Narkovic/Paul’s Boutique/Jochen Schmidt
description: Like other viruses, retroviruses attack cells and force them to produce more retroviruses. This is only the first stage of the attack, because retroviruses nestle in the genome and become part of our DNA.

title: Antriebseffekte beim Segeln
description: Two propulsion effects are used in sailing: drag and buoyancy in combination. Wind pressure and air flow are responsible for the movement.

title: Artensterben im Wandel der Zeit
description: Biodiversity on earth has changed over the past 500 million years. Like a fever curve, it went uphill and steeply downhill a few times. The downward outliers are described as the five major mass extinctions.

title: Aufbau und Funktion eines Giraffenhalses
description: The neck of a giraffe is up to 2.50 meters long, weighs around 250 kilograms and is only held by one tendon and seven cervical vertebrae. It is a particular challenge to the vascular system when the giraffe bends its head down to drink.

title: Bedrohte Löwenpopulationen
artist: ZDF/Tango Film, Pelorus Jack Filmprods LLC/Eva-Maria Gfirtner, Judith Adlhoch/Markus Strobel, Tim Henkel/Jan-Philipp Stahl/Magnet fx/Jochen Schmidt
description: Lions play an important role in the ecological balance in their habitats. It was like that two million years ago. Many populations are now threatened with extinction. The situation in West and Central Africa is particularly critical.

title: Bedrohtes Ökosystem Fluss
description: Too much manure in the water, straightened rivers and locks: three reasons why the habitat of many animals and plants in rivers is under threat.

file: File:Blue Holes auf den Bahamas (CC BY 4.0).webm
title: Blue Holes auf den Bahamas (CC BY 4.0)
artist: ZDF/Terra X/SPIEGEL TV/Christopher Gerisch/Tilman Remme/Reiner Bauer, Oliver Gurr/Oliver Roetz, Philipp Klein/Hauke Ketelsen/Richard Sako
description: Blue holes are cave systems, flooded with sea water. How did the geological treasures develop thousands of years ago?

title: Braucht der Mensch Fleisch?
description: Do we humans need meat for a balanced diet? Our ancestors, the ancestors and early humans, were predominantly fruit-eaters. Today, Germans eat around 60 kilograms of meat a year. Far too much, say critics.

title: Burgleben im Mittelalter
description: At that time, castles were primarily commercial establishments, and the lord of the castle was the manager. The facilities were very sparse, but at least toilets were standard, even if there was no privacy.

file: File:Catalhöyük, erste Großsiedlung der Menschheit (CC by 4.0).webm
title: Catalhöyük, erste Großsiedlung der Menschheit (CC by 4.0)
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Film Produktion Stein e.K./Alexander Hogh/Martin Papirowski/Timm Westen, Roxana Ardelean/Golem Studio/Alexander Leuck/Fraunhofer Intitut für Graphische Datenverarbeitung/Christofori u.Partner
description: Çatalhöyük was the first large settlement in world history. It originated around 9,500 years ago in what is now Turkey. In the heyday, up to 2500 people lived there.

file: File:Creative Commons-Clips zur freien Nutzung – einfach erklärt (Terra X, ZDF).webm
title: Creative Commons-Clips zur freien Nutzung – einfach erklärt
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Bilderfest/Fabian Wolf/Christoph Haag/Ellen Haas, Susanne Hillmann
description: Das Terra X Creative Commons-Angebot der ZDF-Mediathek wird die Art, wie Ihr mit Wissen umgeht, verändern. Hier stellen wir Euch unsere besten Wissensinhalte frei zur Verfügung. Was Ihr dabei beachten müsst, erfahrt Ihr in diesem Explainer-Clip.

title: DDR-Kultauto Trabant
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Dr. Friedrich Scherer/Kawom!/Wolfgang Morell/Maximilian Heß
description: The Trabant is a child of the 1950s. Like any other car of its time, its body framework is made of sheet steel. What is unique are its plastic parts made of thermoset, instead of the usual sheet metal. An innovation born of necessity.

file: File:Darum schlägt der Blitz in Bäume ein.webm
title: Darum schlägt der Blitz in Bäume ein
artist: ZDF/3sat/nano/Autorenkombinat/Josephine Blume, Holger Barthel, Ingo Schwarz /Wiebke Müller /Maximilian Heß
description: The resulting electrical voltage during a thunderstorm reaches several million volts. The lightning bolts shoot from the predominantly negatively charged lower cloud layers through charge tubes to the positively charged surface of the earth.

title: Das Jagdgeheimnis der Florfliege
description: Beaded lacewings (Berothidae) lay their eggs near termite burrows. Once the larvae have hatched, they sneak into the burrow. If a larva encounters termites there, it swings the tip of its rump at the head level of its victim and farts.
